cards.claim: Improved matrix conditioning is not the mechanism explaining Muon's accuracy gains
cards.conditions: Mamba-2 130M, comparing condition number changes to accuracy changes
cards.effect: Condition number improvement decoupled from accuracy improvement; input projection has better conditioning but worse accuracy gain
cards.evidence: Mechanistic analysis: condition number measurement and correlation with accuracy
cards.quote: Conditioning does not explain the gain. Muon lowers the condition number of whichever projection it trains, but the better-conditioned input projection is not the one that helps.
